description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for Virtual Machines using OpenTelemetry host metrics with NVIDIA GPU support

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, 1 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.cpu.time' AND Attributes['cpu']='cpu0' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY exported_job

SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix)/86400 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='system.uptime' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY exported_job

SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, uniqExact(Attributes['cpu']) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.cpu.time' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY exported_job

SELECT exported_job, sumIf(v, state='used') AS used_bytes, sum(v) AS total_bytes, sumIf(v, state='used')/nullIf(sum(v),0)*100 AS real_used_percent, sumIf(v, state!='free')/nullIf(sum(v),0)*100 AS total_used_percent FROM (SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['state'] AS state, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY exported_job, state) GROUP BY exported_job

SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='system.cpu.load_average.1m' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY exported_job

SELECT time, exported_job, (1 - sumIf(rate, state='idle')/nullIf(sum(rate),0))*100 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['state'] AS state, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.cpu.time' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time > $__fromTime GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT time, state AS mode, sum(rate)/nullIf(sum(sum(rate)) OVER (PARTITION BY time),0)*100 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['state'] AS state, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.cpu.time' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time > $__fromTime AND state IN ('user','system','nice','interrupt','softirq','steal','wait','idle') GROUP BY time, mode ORDER BY time

SELECT time, concat(exported_job, ' - Real Used (Applications)') AS exported_job, sumIf(v, state='used')/nullIf(sum(v),0)*100 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['state'] AS state, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, exported_job, state) GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT time, concat(exported_job, ' - Total Used (Including Cache)') AS exported_job, sumIf(v, state!='free')/nullIf(sum(v),0)*100 AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['state'] AS state, avg(Value) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, exported_job, state) GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Used') AS exported_job, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['state']='used' GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Buffers') AS exported_job, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['state']='buffered' GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Cached') AS exported_job, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['state']='cached' GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Free') AS exported_job, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['state']='free' GROUP BY time, exported_job ORDER BY time

SELECT concat(exported_job, ' - ', mountpoint) AS series, exported_job, device, mountpoint, sumIf(v, state='used')/nullIf(sum(v),0)*100 AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['device'] AS device, Attributes['mountpoint'] AS mountpoint, Attributes['state'] AS state, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.filesystem.usage' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['state'] IN ('used','free') AND Attributes['type'] NOT IN ('tmpfs','squashfs') GROUP BY exported_job, device, mountpoint, state) GROUP BY exported_job, device, mountpoint

SELECT time, series, sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - ', Attributes['device'],' - Read') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.disk.io' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['direction']='read' AND NOT match(Attributes['device'], '^loop') WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, -sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - ', Attributes['device'],' - Write') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.disk.io' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['direction']='write' AND NOT match(Attributes['device'], '^loop') WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - ', Attributes['device'],' - RX') AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.network.io' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) AND Attributes['direction']='receive' AND Attributes['device']!='lo' WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Sleeping') AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.processes.count' AND Attributes['status']='sleeping' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Stopped') AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.processes.count' AND Attributes['status']='stopped' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['exported_job'], ' - Zombies') AS series, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='system.processes.count' AND Attributes['status']='zombies' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT c.process_executable_name AS process_executable_name, c.cpu_percent AS cpu_percent, m.memory_bytes AS memory_bytes FROM (SELECT process_executable_name, sum(rate)*100 AS cpu_percent FROM (SELECT Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, Attributes['process_executable_name'] AS process_executable_name, Attributes['process_pid'] AS pid, Attributes['state'] AS state, TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/300 AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='process.cpu.time' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND now() AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE GROUP BY process_executable_name ORDER BY cpu_percent DESC LIMIT 10) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT process_executable_name, sum(v) AS memory_bytes FROM (SELECT Attributes['process_executable_name'] AS process_executable_name, Attributes['process_pid'] AS pid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='process.memory.usage' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY process_executable_name, pid) GROUP BY process_executable_name) m ON m.process_executable_name=c.process_executable_name ORDER BY c.cpu_percent DESC

SELECT container_name, container_image_name, container_id, service_name, exported_job, avg(cpu_percent) AS cpu_percent, avg(memory_percent) AS memory_percent, avg(memory_usage) AS memory_usage FROM (SELECT c.container_name AS container_name, c.container_image_name AS container_image_name, c.container_id AS container_id, c.service_name AS service_name, c.exported_job AS exported_job, c.cpu_percent AS cpu_percent, mp.memory_percent AS memory_percent, mu.memory_usage AS memory_usage FROM (SELECT container_name, container_image_name, container_id, service_name, exported_job, v AS cpu_percent FROM (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, Attributes['container_image_name'] AS container_image_name, Attributes['container_id'] AS container_id, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.cpu.percent' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name, container_image_name, container_id, service_name, exported_job) UNION ALL SELECT container_name, '' AS container_image_name, '' AS container_id, service_name, exported_job, v*100 AS cpu_percent FROM (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.cpu.utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name, service_name, exported_job)) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, Attributes['container_image_name'] AS container_image_name, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS memory_percent FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.memory.percent' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name, container_image_name, service_name, exported_job) mp ON mp.container_name=c.container_name AND mp.exported_job=c.exported_job LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, Attributes['container_image_name'] AS container_image_name, Attributes['service_name'] AS service_name, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS memory_usage FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.memory.usage.total' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name, container_image_name, service_name, exported_job) mu ON mu.container_name=c.container_name AND mu.exported_job=c.exported_job) GROUP BY container_name, container_image_name, container_id, service_name, exported_job ORDER BY cpu_percent DESC

SELECT time, container_name, avg(value) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.cpu.percent' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, container_name UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, avg(Value)*100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.cpu.utilization' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, container_name) GROUP BY time, container_name ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.memory.usage.total' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, container_name ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.blockio.io_service_bytes_recursive.read' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT time, series, sum(rate) AS value FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS series, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/greatest($__interval_s,60) AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.blockio.io_service_bytes_recursive.write' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE time >= $__fromTime GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('container.cpu.percent','container.cpu.utilization') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name)

SELECT count() AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('container.cpu.percent','container.cpu.utilization') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name)

SELECT avg(v) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.cpu.percent' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name UNION ALL SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix)*100 AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.cpu.utilization' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name)

SELECT sum(v) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, Attributes['exported_job'] AS exported_job, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.memory.usage.total' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY container_name, exported_job)

SELECT (SELECT sum(rate) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/300 AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.network.io.usage.rx_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND now() AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) + (SELECT sum(rate) FROM (SELECT TimeUnix, Value - lagInFrame(Value, 1, Value) OVER w AS raw_d, if(raw_d < 0, Value, raw_d) AS d0, if(row_number() OVER w = 1, 0, d0)/300 AS rate FROM otel.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName='container.network.io.usage.tx_bytes' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN now() - INTERVAL 15 MINUTE AND now() AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY ServiceName, ResourceAttributes, Attributes ORDER BY TimeUnix)) WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE) AS value

SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, Attributes['container_name'] AS container_name, avg(Value) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='container.memory.percent' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['exported_job'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, container_name ORDER BY time

panels.title: GPU Metrics (NVIDIA)
panels.description: VM GPU metrics (nvidia_smi_*) are not collected on this fleet. GPU monitoring is available via DCGM_FI_* metrics in Kubernetes only.
The official product name of the GPU. This is an alphanumeric string. For all products.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['modelName']) AS series, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['modelName'] AS name, 1 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, name

panels.title: Name

panels.description: The current performance state for the GPU. States range from P0 (maximum performance) to P12 (minimum performance).

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - P') AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_pstate' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY series

panels.title: P-State

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which one or more kernels was executing on the GPU.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['UUID']) AS series, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix)/100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid

panels.title: GPU Utilization %

panels.description: The last measured power draw for the entire board, in watts. Only available if power management is supported. This reading is accurate to within +/- 5 watts / The software power limit in watts.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(n.host_name, ' - ', n.uuid) AS series, n.host_name AS host_name, n.uuid AS uuid, n.v/nullIf(d.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_power_draw_watts' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) n INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_power_default_limit_watts' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) d ON d.host_name=n.host_name AND d.uuid=n.uuid

panels.title: Power Draw %

panels.description: The fan speed value is the percent of the product's maximum noise tolerance fan speed that the device's fan is currently intended to run at. This value may exceed 100% in certain cases. Note: The reported speed is the intended fan speed. If the fan is physically blocked and unable to spin, this output will not match the actual fan speed. Many parts do not report fan speeds because they rely on cooling via fans in the surrounding enclosure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_fan_speed_ratio' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

panels.title: Fan Speed %

panels.description: Core GPU temperature. in degrees C.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['UUID']) AS series, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_TEMP' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid

panels.title: Temperature

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which global (device) memory was being read or written.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['UUID']) AS series, avg(Value)/100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time

panels.title: Memory Utilization %

panels.description: The version of the installed NVIDIA display driver. This is an alphanumeric string.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['DCGM_FI_DRIVER_VERSION']) AS series, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['DCGM_FI_DRIVER_VERSION'] AS driver_version, 1 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, driver_version

panels.title: Driver Version

panels.description: The BIOS of the GPU board.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['vbios_version']) AS series, 1 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_gpu_info' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY series

panels.title: Vbios Version

panels.description: Information about factors that are reducing the frequency of clocks. If all throttle reasons are returned as "Not Active" it means that clocks are running as high as possible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_gpu_idle','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_gpu_idle') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_thermal_slowdown') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_power_cap','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_power_cap') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_applications_clocks_setting','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_applications_clocks_setting') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_hw_power_brake_slowdown') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sw_thermal_slowdown') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('nvidia_smi_clocks_event_reasons_sync_boost','nvidia_smi_clocks_throttle_reasons_sync_boost') AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name

panels.title: Throttle Reasons

panels.description:
Current frequency of graphics (shader) clock
/
Maximum frequency of graphics (shader) clock.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(n.host_name, ' - ', n.uuid) AS series, n.host_name AS host_name, n.uuid AS uuid, n.v/nullIf(d.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_clocks_current_graphics_clock_hz' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) n INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_clocks_max_graphics_clock_hz' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) d ON d.host_name=n.host_name AND d.uuid=n.uuid

panels.title: GPU Clock Speed %

panels.description: Current frequency of memory clock / Maximum frequency of memory clock

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(n.host_name, ' - ', n.uuid) AS series, n.host_name AS host_name, n.uuid AS uuid, n.v/nullIf(d.v,0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_clocks_current_memory_clock_hz' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) n INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='nvidia_smi_clocks_max_memory_clock_hz' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) d ON d.host_name=n.host_name AND d.uuid=n.uuid

panels.title: Memory Clock Speed %

panels.description: Total memory allocated by active contexts / Total installed GPU memory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(u.host_name, ' - ', u.uuid) AS series, u.host_name AS host_name, u.uuid AS uuid, u.v/nullIf(u.v+f.v+ifNull(r.v,0),0) AS value FROM (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) u INNER JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) f ON f.host_name=u.host_name AND f.uuid=u.uuid LEFT JOIN (SELECT Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_RESERVED' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid) r ON r.host_name=u.host_name AND r.uuid=u.uuid

panels.title: Memory Allocation %

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which global (device) memory was being read or written.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.

targets.rawSql: SELECT concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['UUID']) AS series, Attributes['host_name'] AS host_name, Attributes['UUID'] AS uuid, argMax(Value, TimeUnix)/100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_MEM_COPY_UTIL' AND TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 5 MINUTE AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY host_name, uuid

panels.title: Memory Utilization %

panels.description:
Percent of time over the past sample period during which one or more kernels was executing on the GPU.
The sample period may be between 1 second and 1/6 second depending on the product.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfInterval(TimeUnix, INTERVAL greatest($__interval_s,60) SECOND) AS time, concat(Attributes['host_name'], ' - ', Attributes['UUID']) AS series, avg(Value)/100 AS value FROM otel.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName='DCGM_FI_DEV_GPU_UTIL' AND TimeUnix BETWEEN $__fromTime AND $__toTime AND $__conditionalAll(Attributes['host_name'] IN (${vm:singlequote}), $vm) GROUP BY time, series ORDER BY time
